review_candidates.title: Founding Operations (EA / Office Manager)
review_candidates.description: About Us MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. That has to start from trust. Our first product is an MCP gateway that gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on. We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how. We are AI-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them. Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co-founded Coursera. The Job You keep the founders' time and our offices running. You own the founders' calendars: protect their focus time, triage a constant stream of requests, resolve conflicts before they reach them, and make sure nothing gets dropped. You support our San Mateo and SF offices so no one else has to think about them: space, supplies, vendors, and visitors. You also work very cross-functionally and pitch in to help keep the wider team on schedule as needed. You are among the first ops hires who sees almost everything, so trust and discretion matter as much as speed. We are an AI-native company. With our help, you'll build agentic workflows in our own product to streamline your work, so you're able to make better judgment calls. The role is hybrid in the Bay Area. About You Likely 2 to 4 yrs as an admin, coordinator, or team assistant, and you are ready to step into a full EA and office manager role. You have high judgment and discretion. You will see calendars, sensitive conversations, and comp-adjacent information, and you treat all of it with care. You stay calm when everything is interrupting you, and you will hold the line with an exec when the calendar says no. You have high attention to detail, and you are organized to the point that things simply do not fall through the cracks. You are a fast learner who is AI-native, or will get there fast, and you would rather build a workflow than repeat a task by hand. You have a strong desire to grow, and you are excited to learn the parts of the job you have not done yet. Nice to have: You have built or directed AI agents or agentic workflows, not just used AI tools. You have supported a founder or senior exec before. You have run an office, or managed vendors and space. You are comfortable with tools, spreadsheets, or a CRM, and have used automation to make scheduling faster. What we offer: Competitive compensation and meaningful equity. The chance to build the ops function of an AI-native company from the ground up, with room to grow. Direct access to the founders and to how the company actually runs. Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first. Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp

We zijn een klein maar gedreven team waar de boog niet altijd gespannen is en waarbij samenwerken, communicatie en gedrevenheid enorm worden geapprecieerd. Functieomschrijving Als expediteur ben jij de onmisbare schakel in onze internationale logistieke keten. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het van A tot Z organiseren, coördineren en administratief afhandelen van goederenstromen. Je onderhoudt dagelijks contacten met klanten, rederijen, transporteurs en douanediensten om ervoor te zorgen dat elke zending efficiënt en vlot op de eindbestemming geraakt. Takenpakket Dossierbeheer: Zelfstandig opstarten, opvolgen en afhandelen van transportdossiers (Import / Export / Transit). Klantencontact & Service: Fungeren als centraal aanspreekpunt voor klanten en partners; proactief updates geven en adviseren over tarieven en routes. Logistieke planning: Boeken van transporten via zeevracht, luchtvracht of wegtransport en onderhandelen over concurrerende vrachttarieven. Documentatie: Opmaken, verwerken en controleren van de nodige transport-, export- en douanedocumenten (Incoterms, cognossementen/BL, transitdocumenten). Financiële administratie: Inbrengen, controleren en factureren van de gemaakte kosten per dossier. Problem-solving: Snel en efficiënt oplossen van operationele problemen of vertragingen tijdens het transporttraject Jouw profiel Ervaring/Opleiding: Je beschikt over een bachelordiploma (bv. Logistiek Management) of bent gelijkwaardig door relevante werkervaring in de forwarding- of expeditie-sector. Vakkennis: Grondige kennis van transportdocumenten, Incoterms en basisprincipes van douaneformaliteiten. Talenkennis: Zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels (geschreven en gesproken). Kennis van het Frans of andere talen is een sterke troef. Competenties: Je werkt uiterst nauwkeurig, bent stressbestendig en kan vlot prioriteiten stellen in een dynamische omgeving. Software: Je bent digitaal vaardig en pikt bedrijfseigen logistieke software (Fordesk) snel op. Ons aanbod Verloning: Een aantrekkelijk en marktconform loonpakket, afgestemd op jouw ervaring. Extralegale voordelen: Maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering. Werkomgeving: Een boeiende, uitdagende functie binnen een collegiaal en groeiend team met ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheden tot glijdende werkuren en/of deels thuiswerk

review_candidates.title: Executive Assistant Operations Manager
review_candidates.description: About the Company Executive Assistant & Operations Manager Remote | South Africa Full-time We’re looking for a highly capable Executive Assistant & Operations Manager to work closely with two co-founders of a small international recruitment business. About the Role You’ll be responsible for making the founders more effective, keeping the business organised, driving follow-through across projects, and improving the systems and processes that sit behind the company. We’re looking for someone intelligent, proactive and highly organised who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems and building structure where it doesn’t yet exist. Responsibilities Executive & Administrative Support Manage calendars across both founders Manage and prioritise inboxes across Outlook and LinkedIn Maintain founder to-do lists and ensure important actions are completed Coordinate meetings, travel and logistics Support personal administration where required Assist with expenses, bookkeeping and basic finance administration Make sure commitments don’t get forgotten and deadlines don’t slip Sales & Recruitment Support Prepare founders for client, candidate and business development meetings Ensure relevant notes, documents and context are available before meetings Support client and candidate communication Make sure every candidate, client and prospect receives a timely response Track follow-ups and outstanding actions Coordinate interviews and meetings Maintain accurate CRM and internal records Project Management Own internal project trackers Keep projects moving by managing deadlines, owners and next actions Identify blockers early and escalate them before they become urgent Coordinate operational and administrative projects Organise company data, documents, templates and shared folders Support operational projects relating to our international business structure Process, Automation & AI Document existing processes and workflows Build and maintain SOPs, templates and checklists Create a central source of truth for company processes Identify repetitive or inefficient work Recommend and implement simpler ways of working Improve how we use software, automation and AI Build workflows that reduce manual administration and founder involvement Working Hours & Flexibility This is a full-time role and you should generally expect to work standard 9–5 hours in South Africa. However, the founders travel frequently and often work across different time zones, so some flexibility is required. From time to time, you may need to: Support meetings or requests outside standard working hours Adjust your schedule when the founders are travelling Handle occasional time-sensitive issues in the early morning or evening We do not expect you to be permanently online or available 24/7. The expectation is that you are flexible, responsive and comfortable supporting an internationally distributed business when circumstances require it. Where additional flexibility is needed, we aim to manage working hours sensibly rather than treating the role as a rigid 9–5. What success looks like. Within your first few months: The founders spend significantly less time on administration Important actions and follow-ups rarely get missed Meetings are properly prepared for Company information is organised and easy to find Internal projects have clear ownership and momentum Core processes are documented Repetitive work is increasingly automated You are proactively solving problems before the founders need to ask Qualifications We care more about evidence of ability than a specific background. Required Skills You’ll likely be a strong fit if you can demonstrate: Exceptional organisation and attention to detail High intelligence and strong problem-solving ability Ownership and a bias toward action Strong written and verbal communication The ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities Experience working directly with founders or senior executives Experience building processes, systems or operations from scratch Strong comfort with technology and learning new tools Practical use of AI and automation to improve efficiency The ability to work independently in a remote environment High levels of integrity and discretion Preferred Skills Particularly valuable experience. We’d be especially interested if you have previously: Worked in a small, founder-led business Built an EA, operations or internal systems function from 0 → 1 Implemented CRM, project management or workflow systems Automated repetitive administrative processes Used AI tools to materially improve how a business operates Worked in recruitment, professional services, consulting or a similar environment Pay range and compensation package Compensation - $2,000-$3,000 USD per month depending on experience.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Title: ERP Business Analyst Id: 21410 Type: FullTime Location: Bolton, ON At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! The ERP Business Systems Analyst role is focused on developing a deep functional and technical understanding of key business systems and identifying the most effective ways to leverage them. In this role, you will collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to plan, design, and implement digital solutions that drive efficiency and business value through the use of new and existing technologies. Key Responsibilities Conduct meetings and workshops with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements. Critically evaluate information from multiple sources, reconcile conflicting requirements, decompose high-level concepts into detailed requirements, and distinguish user requests from underlying business needs. Analyze existing business processes and collaborate with stakeholders to refine, optimize, and develop new processes where required. Develop deep functional and technical expertise in ERP systems (primarily Infor LN), related applications, and supporting business processes. Identify system gaps and recommend solutions to meet evolving business needs. Create and maintain project documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, use cases, test cases, and other project artifacts throughout the project lifecycle. Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and IT project teams, ensuring alignment of requirements, priorities, and deliverables. Develop test plans, coordinate testing activities, execute system validation, and support business users during User Acceptance Testing (UAT). Deliver training and knowledge transfer to end users and support teams on new processes, system enhancements, and project deliverables. Provide post-implementation support, troubleshooting, and subject matter expertise to ensure successful adoption of implemented solutions. Act as Tier 3 support for escalated issues involving Infor LN and other ERP applications, working closely with service desk and technical support teams to resolve complex issues. Critical Capabilities Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong team player with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams with minimal supervision. Strong facilitation skills, including meeting planning and preparation, clear presentation of ideas, effective moderation of discussions, and the ability to drive alignment and consensus. Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workloads, manage multiple tasks, and consistently meet deadlines. Proven hands-on experience supporting and administering Infor LN. Advanced troubleshooting, configuration, and application support skills with Infor LN. Experience with Infor Baan IV, Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012, or ProAlpha ERP systems is considered an asset. Advanced business process knowledge in one or more of the following areas: Finance, Discrete Manufacturing, Engineer-to-Order (ETO) Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Warehouse Management, and Service Management. Solid understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies and business analysis best practices. Experience working within Agile and project delivery methodologies. Fluency in English is required. Ability to translate complex business requirements into practical system solutions and recommendations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a continuous improvement mindset. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related) 4+ years’ experience as a technical business analyst or application specialist preferred. 4+ years process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset. 3+ years of experience working with Infor LN. Pay Range: $95,000 - $120,000 Vacancy: Replacement Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner. Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
